instruction: Use ug-surveillance cameras to list all cameras with name, location and status. Read only. Do not return faces, plates or snapshots.

Use ug-document extract with schema auto and content-scope full on the file Invoices/Ana Ruiz - Nov week 1.pdf. Return one row per billed visit with date, start time, end time, billed hours, hourly rate and line amount, plus the exact text each value was read from. Also return the bill total, currency and the period printed on the bill. Leave a value empty when it is not printed; do not compute or infer missing values. List any page or line that could not be read.

Use ug-surveillance event-timeline from 2026-11-02 00:00 to 2026-11-08 23:59 in time zone America/New_York, for the cameras Front Door, with topic Human and HumanFace, identity-type known, person-name Ana Ruiz and limit 500. Return every event with its event id, local time, camera and the identity name exactly as recorded. Read only. Do not return events of any other person. Report any warning about missing recordings or offline cameras.

Use ug-surveillance event-timeline from 2026-11-02 00:00 to 2026-11-08 23:59 in time zone America/New_York, for the cameras Front Door, with identity-type all and limit 500. Return only, for each camera and each day, the number of events and the times of events. Do not return names, faces, plates, snapshots or event details. Report any warning about missing recordings or offline cameras.
